# PageTemplate

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

Builds page templates from elements instead of a function.

Namespace `BonniePDF`.

## Methods

- [`FromElements`](#fromelements): Builds a page template from elements.
- [`TryGetElements`](#trygetelements): Reads back the elements a template was built from.

### `FromElements`

```csharp
Func<int, IElement> FromElements(IElement default = null, IElement firstPage = null, IElement odd = null, IElement even = null)
```

*static*

Builds a page template from elements.

Example:

```csharp
doc.Settings.FooterTemplate = PageTemplate.FromElements( @default: new TextBlock { Text = "Page {{CurrentPage}} of {{TotalPages}}" }, firstPage: new TextBlock { Text = "Confidential" });
```
